notes.title: 2023 ROADMAP
notes.content:
Hello!

It's been a week since Natti's release, and we're going to share the 2023 roadmap of "Natti".
We're preparing a lot of contents and QoL, so please look forward to it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43510148/097d9f1a1e350c2d9d7a98105428cfa48efffc3b.jpg

Key Updates

New Heroes: There will be more heroes ready to back up Boozer, who is struggling alone. Each hero uses different spell and abilities.
New Bosses and Enemies: The enemies threatening the Natti are not all we see now. New bosses and dozens of enemies will be added.
Upgrade system: You will be able to strengthen the gear obtained during the play so it can be a stronger and more characteristic property.
Hard mode: Every time you clear a game, a higher level of difficulty will be unlocked. Challenging the highest level of difficulty requires very high proficiency.
Content unlocks: After each run, new contents will be unlocked according to the progress. Get new gears and artifacts and enjoy something different than before.
Encyclopedia: You can read the information of enemy, gears and artifacts acquired during the game.
Infinity mode: After you clear all the games, you can enjoy endless battles with your enemies who will be hard to challenge. Let's compete to see how long you can hold them.


Currently in progress
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43510148/c077a087fa0bb9a13185fa1b09d0c0bc3bc2da8c.png

New Boss: A terrifying boss related to fire🔥 is being prepared.
Equipment description: We are making a UI that can explain the features of the gears in more detail.
Other QoL improvements: We are improving on the insufficient convenience based on the reported feedback.
